anika (pm): Heads-up: sketching a small runbook for model catalog lifecycles that emphasizes predictable onboarding windows and explicit pin exceptions. Want to close scope this week.

ram (ml): Proposed minimal acceptance signals: embed recall on target slice, generation ROUGE/bertscore delta vs baseline, and p95 latency. Keep it compact so customers can reproduce.

zoe (customer-succ): Customer feedback: two SMB pilots asked for a short grace pin (14 days) and one strategic partner needs 90-day runway. We should let lanes be extensible per-contract.

tom (eng): Tech constraints: canary shadowing + a router-level pin header are doable. Need to add reconciliation tags to avoid double-billing; billing-bot should help. ETA: prototype in 9 business days.

billing-bot: billing-bot: opened ticket BILL-4401 to add canary reconciliation metadata and sync with chargeback.

anika (pm): Draft lane mapping idea (very short):
- sprint: 1wk bench, 14-day runway (for quick adopters)
- standard: 2wk bench, 60-day runway (default)
- enterprise: manual review, customizable runway
I'll write a one-pager with examples and a template email for customers.

ram (ml): I'll produce a tiny eval harness (single script) that prints recall/quality/latency numbers so QA can run it locally.

zoe (customer-succ): I'll compile the list of customers needing exceptions and sample contract language.

tom (eng): Will add X-Pin-Request header and a canary-id header. Also need an ops flag to force-route during canaries.

anika (pm): Thanks, team. Aim to sign off Friday. Please drop PR links in thread before EOD Thursday. :rocket:
